metric_definitions.evidence_atom_recall_at_k: Retrievable Gold atoms covered by a candidate in Top-K divided by retrievable Gold atoms. Atoms without an acceptable span are excluded from this denominator and reported as corpus gaps.
metric_definitions.candidate_precision_at_k: Candidates in Top-K with evidence grade >= 2 divided by K.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first candidate with evidence grade >= 2; cases without such a candidate are excluded from the MRR denominator.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: Standard graded-gain nDCG over the common evidence-item unit with grades 3/2/1/0.
metric_definitions.k0_precision_recall: Not evaluated for this frozen baseline because the baseline has no candidate-sufficiency output and returns K candidates for a non-empty pool.
metric_definitions.false_positive_candidate_rate: Expected-K0 cases with at least one grade >= 2 candidate in Top-K divided by expected-K0 cases.
metric_definitions.false_negative_k0_rate: Expected non-K0 cases for which the baseline returned zero candidates divided by expected non-K0 cases.
metric_definitions.f1: Not emitted in V1 because atom recall and candidate precision use different units.

evidence: Blind GPT semantic Gold is frozen for 10 cases, but the immutable baseline contains vectors for only the three calibration cases.
The seven untouched holdout cases cannot be scored without new query embeddings, and no Provider call is authorized by this P0 decision.
Changing chunking, ranking, or K0 before holdout replay would violate the approved calibration/holdout gate.
